curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8062-1/ (scans; the file builds the ice hockey player and goal, pages 2-10, steps 1-17; the other models after)

functions.does: Swinging the player's upper body sweeps the hockey stick across the ice at the puck (a crown gear): the torso sits on an axle that a universal joint links to an upright shaft in the hips, so the torso turns on the hips and carries the arm and stick with it.
functions.source: book: steps 5-6 (hip shaft and universal joint), 12-15 (torso on the axle, arm and stick) and 17 (puck and goal); how it is worked inferred, as the book draws no arrows

functions.does: The stick is held on two axles between the hand's two yellow liftarms, so it stays fixed to the arm.
